sources.attribution: Supreme Court of the United States, electronic docket
sources.authority: Supreme Court of the United States
sources.geographicCoverage: A curated list of U.S. Supreme Court dockets. Lower federal courts and state courts are not covered by this source.
knownLimitations: Coverage is a hand-curated seed list (pipeline/seeds/cases.json), not every election-law case, and not every election case the Court has heard.
The record is read from the Court's docket web page, so a change to that page's layout stops the import until the reader is updated. The last verified copy stays published.
The Court's JSON files for the same dockets are not used: its robots.txt asks robots to stay out of the folder they are in.
Docket entries are classified by keyword rules; DemocracyHQ never derives an overall case status.
Filing links are published as the docket gives them and are not individually tested. Only the opinion and order links inside entries are tested on each run.
The absence of a case here says nothing about whether litigation exists.
sources.license: The Court's docket pages, orders and opinions are U.S. Government works, not subject to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. § 105). The Questions Presented text, shown in full, usually reproduces the words of the party that sought review, and the short passages quoted from filings are the filers' own words. Words written by a State or a private party are not U.S. Government works; they are shown for reference. Filings are linked, not mirrored.
sources.name: Supreme Court of the United States, public docket pages
sources.statusDetail: 5 opinion or order link(s) given on the Court's dockets answered not found when checked; they are published as unavailable, with the date of the check, and the case pages show their addresses as text, not as links
sources.temporalCoverage: The dockets in the seed list, all numbered 16- or later. Earlier dockets have not been tried.
sources.updateCadence: Each docket re-checked on every pipeline run (scheduled daily), requests at least 1.1 seconds apart

sources.attribution: California Legislative Information (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov), Legislative Counsel of California
knownLimitations: Only bills whose latest official subject line matches selection rule ca-select-2 (after its exclusion pattern is applied) are included; an election-related bill with a different subject line is missed.
Effective dates and ballot outcomes are not in the source and are not asserted.
The public site leginfo.legislature.ca.gov blocks automated requests, so links to it are constructed from official identifiers and are not machine-checked.
Extraordinary sessions and prior sessions are not yet ingested.
sources.license: Published for public access under Cal. Gov. Code § 10248. Bill text is a government edict; DemocracyHQ republishes extracted text with attribution and does not redistribute the CAML XML files, which carry a Legislative Counsel Bureau copyright notice.
